Dr Jane McNamara
Neurologist
10 Autumn Street
Newtown

26 January 2016

Dear Dr McNamara

Re: Mrs Tianna Buckley, 66 years old.

I am referring Mrs Buckley who is suffering from vertigo and has been
diagnosed with syncope. I would like to request that you treat Mrs Buckley
as required and monitor her compliance with medication.

Mrs Buckley first presented on 22 January 2016 with recurring episodes of
vertigo. She had suffered a 12 kg weight loss in the previous 6 months.
During hospitalisation she was given a CT scan of her head, which showed
reduced blood flow to the brain and some atrophy. However, no focal
weakness was noticed and Mrs Buckley denied having headaches or recent
changes in vision or speech. She has been diagnosed with syncope and is
being discharged from our care today.

Please note that Mrs Buckley has a history of type 2 diabetes, which is well
managed with diet.

She is currently prescribed the following oral medications: Cardizem 90 mg
and Allopurinol 100 mg twice daily, Digoxin 0.125 mg once a day, plus
Coumadin 4 mg and Remeron 15 mg orally each hour.

I would like to refer Mrs Buckley for your assessment and management of
her neurological condition. Also I would kindly request you to monitor her
compliance with medication.

If you have any further queries please do not hesitate to contact me.

Yours sincerely,

Charge Nurse
